items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I work with Paul Bobran. I've been all around the country with Paul Bobran... I played at New Orleans Country Club with Paul.

ctx.x: You understand what I'm talking about?

They ain't got to give you a glass of water. You understand? Them people is paying you to play. Now, if they want to give you water, they give you water. You understand what I mean? They feel like giving you water, they give you water. Before I make the people give you nothing, them people ain't supposed to give you nothing. They ain't supposed to give you nothing. What you got, some fellas playing, they're talking, man, why don't you ask a man to give me a bottle? Okay, just a drink. You know what I tell them? I…
it makes you play your horn.
